title: Minute Out In It: Bobcat & Mallard
licence: Public domain — work of the U.S. National Park Service (federal government). NPS media pages: items without a © symbol or non-NPS credit are public domain. Credit line recorded below.
contents: Bobcat on a snowy riverbank of the Madison River stalks mallards, crouches behind a boulder, then dives in and swims after the ducks (they escape), climbing out soaked onto a snowy log. Natural sound only, no narration.
